name: Citizenship by Descent (Jus Sanguinis)

requirements.blocker_text: Law No. 03/L-034 on Citizenship, Article 6: a child born to two Kosovo-citizen parents acquires citizenship automatically. If only one parent is a Kosovo citizen, the child acquires it if born in Kosovo, born abroad to a stateless or unknown-nationality other parent, or born abroad with both parents' written consent submitted before the child turns 14. The rule applies equally regardless of which parent holds citizenship -- no paternal/maternal preference.
requirements.fix_path: Establish the parental link to a Kosovo-citizen parent; for a birth abroad with only one Kosovo-citizen parent, submit both parents' written consent before the child turns 14.

evidence_required.document: Both parents' written consent (birth abroad, one citizen parent, before age 14)

sources.title: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo (government-hosted primary legal text) -- Law No. 03/L-034 on Citizenship, Article 6 (descent) and Article 3 (dual citizenship)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kosovo). STATUS: DRAFT despite tier-1 sourcing -- an honest, deliberate downgrade, not a validator-driven one. Law No. 03/L-034 (2008) is confirmed to have been superseded at least once, by Law No. 04/L-215 (2013), which was itself abolished by Law No. 10/L-023, effective 6 May 2026 -- barely 4 months before this build. Reporting on the 2026 reform found in this build focused specifically on simplifying DIASPORA REACQUISITION (documents cut from 9 to 1, processing cut from 6 months to 30 days, fee removed -- see xk_citizenship_naturalisation.json), not on descent rules -- suggesting continuity is LIKELY but is NOT independently confirmed against the current operative text. This file is marked draft specifically to flag that residual uncertainty, even though the cited source is unambiguously a tier-1 government legal text. dual_citizenship_allowed set to true per Article 3, with the same supersession caveat.
